name: GAN i4 3x3 Leap (Magnetic, Ball-Core) - Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The GAN i4 3x3 (Magnetic, Ball-Core) - Bluetooth Smart Cube is a premium magnetic speed cube built for cubers who want strong turning performance with smart training features built in. Standard magnets help pieces click into place more accurately, while the Ball-Core adds stability and a more controlled feel.
features: Smarter practice: Zero-loss sensing and omni-motion monitoring capture turning data to help you train more intentionally.
More controlled feel: Ball-Core stability helps the cube feel more predictable during faster solves.
Fast, accurate turning: Standard magnets improve alignment and give the cube a cleaner, more precise feel.
Flexible battery options: Performance and endurance modes let you choose between full smart features or longer battery life.
Established smart ecosystem: Built for a smartcubing community with over 1.5 million players.
72 handfeel options: Designed to give you a wide range of setup possibilities.
